question: Which state's government launched Gruha Lakshmi Scheme 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Telangana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Telangana** state government launched the **Gruha Lakshmi Scheme 2023**.
 
• The scheme was revealed by **Telangana Chief Minister, Mr. Kalvakuntla Chandrashekar Rao**.
 
• The initiative aims to **provide financial aid to Dalit women to help them build homes**.
 
• The government will provide a **one-time subsidy of Rs. 3 lakh** to help eligible women construct their own homes.
 
• A budget of **Rs. 12 crore** has been set aside by the Telangana state government.
 
• This budget is aimed at constructing **4 lakh public housing units**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
Here are the eligibility criteria for the **Gruha Lakshmi Scheme 2023** based on the provided information:

 
 
• **Target Group**: The scheme is specifically designed for **Dalit women** in Telangana.
 
• **Financial Condition**: The scheme is intended for Dalit families who are unable to build their homes due to **financial constraints**.
 
• **Gender-Specific**: Only **female recipients** are eligible for the scheme.
 
• **Citizenship**: The beneficiaries must be **residents of Telangana**.
 
• **Land Ownership**: Eligible women should either own land or have access to land for home construction (land distribution is handled separately from the scheme).
